title: recursion detection fails with an internal error of the equality check raises a valid typeerror (numpy)

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: problem that needs to be addressed

labels.name: topic: reporting
labels.description: related to terminal output and user-facing messages and errors

body:
Here is a simple way to reproduce:

```python
import numpy

def a(x):
    return b(numpy.arange(10))

def b(x):
    return a(numpy.arange(10))

def test_recursion():
    a(numpy.arange(10))
```
